title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the excitation energy, E = 13.40 MeV.

title: Energy Difference Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the energy difference using the binding energies provided.

title: Coulomb Energy Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the correct formula for the Coulomb energy difference between isospin states.

title: Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly use the constants for the neutron-proton mass difference and the radius formula.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the energy difference calculation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors in the Coulomb energy formula.
